{{Infobox character|name=Orrin|house=[[House Stormrider]]|role=Rider|age=~26}}
'''Orrin''' shares no blood with the Binder's line, but people unite in his presence the way the old ones say they did around the young [[Garron, the Binder|Garron]]. He has shown no wish for power — which the house's meritocracy counts both for and against him.
